singleDescription: Choose a print format and size.
selected: {count, plural, one {# QR code selected} other {# QR codes selected}}
limits: All {count} selected codes · up to {limit} per ZIP · 512 MiB maximum.
printRules: Four quiet modules, Q error correction (H with a logo), and at least 3:1 contrast.
minimum: Recommended minimum print size: {size} mm at 300 dpi.
expiresHint: Downloads expire 24 hours after you start the export.
reviewHint: Browse the selected codes below. Filters only change this list; the ZIP includes all {count} selected codes.
emptyFiltered: No selected codes match these filters.
disabled: Print exports are not available right now.
leaveHint: You can leave this page. The export will continue in the background.

errors.unavailable: This export or selection is unavailable. Return to QR codes and choose again.
errors.invalid_export: Choose a valid format, size and up to 500 QR codes.
errors.not_found: The selection changed or contains an unavailable code. Return to the library and choose again.
errors.forbidden: Your access changed. Ask a workspace owner to check your membership.
errors.failed: The export could not be prepared. Try again.
errors.low_contrast: The design contrast is too low for print. Review its colors and try again.
errors.invalid_color: The design has an unsupported color. Review its colors and try again.
errors.invalid_design: This design cannot be exported for print yet. Review its settings.
errors.invalid_data: This code contains too much or unsupported data. Review the code before exporting.
errors.invalid_size: This size is too small for the code. Choose a larger size.
errors.logo_unavailable: The logo is unavailable for print. Replace or remove it and try again.
errors.storage_unavailable: The download service is temporarily unavailable. The export will retry; refresh the status if needed.
errors.archive_too_large: The ZIP exceeds 512 MiB. Select fewer codes or choose a smaller size.
errors.access_removed: Access to a selected code changed. Return to the library and choose again.
errors.snapshot_missing: The saved selection is incomplete. Return to the library and start a new export.
errors.expired: This export has expired. Return to QR codes and prepare a new download.
